answers_to_adversarial_questions.q1_is_M1prime_useful: M1' is useful, not a meaningless rename. It is a valid daemon-side health signal especially for stuck pendingCount, unexpected lastSweepRemoved, and proving /list sees mapping state. It is NOT S2 fd-scan telemetry — caller must label this honestly.
answers_to_adversarial_questions.q2_tid_slice_direction: Use last 8 chars (slice(-8)), not first 8. UUIDv7 prefix chars collide by time. PID is already separately available in /list/mapping; do not include pid in process.title.
answers_to_adversarial_questions.q3_cgroup_parsing: Capture both raw string AND minimal parsed view: { raw: string, version: 'v1' | 'v2' | 'mixed' | 'unknown', paths: string[], readAt: string }. Keep parsing shallow; raw preserves future compatibility.
answers_to_adversarial_questions.q4_other_items: No other prior-cycle items should be pulled in now, except documentation of dependencies. Keep persistence.ts atomic refactor deferred. Offline reconnect and deeper PID-reuse/start-time hardening are real but broader than this 'remaining deferred codex tracking' pass.
